title: Several targets on one rule line
objective: Put f1.o and f2.o on a single rule line and confirm that the recipe runs once for each target.
hint: f1.o f2.o: is shorthand for two rules with the same recipe. $@ expands to whichever target is being built.

steps.description: the recipe is run twice, once per target
steps.stdout:
echo f1.o
f1.o
echo f2.o
f2.o

steps.description: the dry run shows the recipe printed once per target
writing the two rules out is exactly equivalent
steps.stdout:
echo f1.o
f1.o
echo f2.o
f2.o
